title: Inspect the denied-guest branch
audience: Developers reviewing the prepared checkout fixture
purpose: Explain how to inspect the gate and recognize the relevant assertion without running the fixture.
scope: Read-only inspection of checkout.py and test_checkout.py.

sections.title: Before inspection
sections.content: Locate checkout.py, test_checkout.py, and the prepared contract in the same fixture snapshot.

sections.title: Inspection steps
sections.content: Read the implementation and assertion together.
steps: Open the checkout function and find the falsey-user condition.
Find the guest_checkout setting read and the 401 result.
Compare the corresponding test assertion; do not report it as executed.

sections.title: Expected inspection result
sections.content: The implementation and test assertion both identify status 401 with requires_login true when guest checkout is disabled.

sections.title: When evidence disagrees
sections.content: Use the cited current implementation and recorded contract to describe the discrepancy; a stale README is not execution evidence.

examples.title: Assertion to recognize
examples.prerequisites: Read the surrounding test setup before interpreting this assertion.
examples.expected: Recognize the denied-guest assertion; this snippet is illustrative and is not executed.

validation.reason: Prepared read-only illustration; no execution claim.

review_when: the cited assertion or conditional changes.
